structure.jp: にしに　ある　グレン　じまは
structure.en: Cinnabar Island, which is to the west,

structure.jp: ポケモン　けんきゅうの　しま！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: にしに　ある　グレン　じま
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put right before a thing, describes that thing. にしに ある グレン じま = 'Cinnabar Island, which is to the west'.
